description: The four stateless 'callee' sync services with NO inter-service dependencies: payment-processor-sim, ml-scoring-service, llm-gateway, and decision-engine. These are the leaf services the orchestrator and agents call. Depends on FEAT-001 (topic map + config keys + workspace glob) because each service is a new uv workspace member importing acip-common. Independent of FEAT-003/FEAT-004 at the code level, but ordered before them because the orchestrator (FEAT-003) and checkout-api (FEAT-004) call these. Each follows the identical service skeleton: services/<name>/ with Dockerfile (python:3.11-slim, uv install, non-root user), pyproject.toml (uv workspace member, acip-common = { workspace = true }), src/<module>/main.py FastAPI app with GET /healthz + GET /readyz, 12-factor config via acip_common.config.Settings, structured logging via acip_common.logging, and pytest tests.
steps: payment-processor-sim (docs/06 §2 'payment-processor-sim contract'): services/payment-processor-sim/ with src/payment_processor_sim/{__init__.py,main.py,sim.py} and tests/test_sim.py. POST /v1/charge takes {transaction_id,amount,currency,route} and returns {status: CAPTURED|DECLINED, processor, auth_code, latency_ms}. Behavior driven by Settings.sim_approval_rate, sim_latency_ms, and the new sim_failure_mode (none|timeout|error): on failure mode produce the simulated failure. Make the approve/decline draw seedable so tests are deterministic. Reuse Settings + configure_logging.

ml-scoring-service (docs/05 §2, §5, §7): services/ml-scoring-service/ with src/ml_scoring_service/{__init__.py,main.py,loader.py,scorer.py,heuristic.py} and tests/test_scoring.py. At startup, loader resolves artifacts from <ML_MODELS_DIR>/model_card.json (models.risk.artifact XGBoost .json via xgboost.XGBClassifier/Booster.load_model; models.fraud.artifact LightGBM .txt via lightgbm.Booster(model_file=...)), performs a warm-up predict, and /readyz returns ready only after load. POST /v1/score {model: risk|fraud, model_version, features, metadata} returns {score, model, model_version, top_features:[{name,contribution}], latency_ms}; order the feature vector by acip_common.features.FEATURE_COLUMNS; derive top_features from gain/feature-importance. If model_card.json or artifacts are missing, serve the deterministic heuristic (heuristic.py) returning a bounded score + model_version='heuristic-v1' and log a degraded notice (docs/05 §5). Pin deps xgboost==2.1.3, lightgbm==4.5.0, numpy==2.1.3 to match ml/pyproject.toml. In compose (FEAT-004) ml/models is mounted read-only at ML_MODELS_DIR.

llm-gateway (docs/04): services/llm-gateway/ with src/llm_gateway/{__init__.py,main.py,breaker.py,providers/{__init__.py,base.py,mock.py,gemini.py}} and tests/test_gateway.py. base.py defines the LLMProvider Protocol (async complete(req)->resp, async health()) + LLMRequest/LLMResponse/TokenUsage/ProviderHealth dataclasses (docs/04 §2). mock.py = deterministic MockAdapter producing structured {rationale, evidence} with no network. gemini.py = GeminiAdapter using the Google GenAI/Vertex SDK via ADC, imported lazily inside the adapter so the package imports without the SDK or creds. POST /v1/complete {system,prompt,response_schema,metadata} returns a normalized LLMResponse. Provider chosen by Settings.llm_provider; breaker.py is a per-provider circuit breaker with timeout+retry (docs/04 §5) that short-circuits to Settings.llm_fallback_provider (mock) when the primary fails or ADC resolution raises at startup, so the stack runs with NO creds (docs/04 §4). Pin any added deps.

decision-engine (docs/06 §2 /v1/decide, docs/02 §5): services/decision-engine/ with src/decision_engine/{__init__.py,main.py,aggregator.py} and tests/test_aggregator.py. aggregator.py is a pure function taking the set of agent Verdicts (acip_common.schemas.Verdict keyed by AgentName), candidate routes, and Settings, implementing docs/02 §5 in order: (1) hard veto - policy deny OR fraud score >= Settings.fraud_block_threshold -> DECLINE; (2) weighted composite = w_risk*risk + w_fraud*fraud banded by approve_max/challenge_max; (3) routing overlay (top route + alternatives); (4) merchant soft constraints (e.g. force CHALLENGE on high value); (5) checkout-personalization advisory recommended_method (never changes the decision). Missing-verdict policy: missing risk or fraud -> Settings.missing_risk_fraud_policy (default CHALLENGE); missing advisory agents -> defaults. ALL thresholds/weights from Settings, never hardcoded. Return a DecisionRenderedPayload-shaped object (docs/02 §5). POST /v1/decide wraps the pure aggregator. Reuse Verdict, DecisionHint, AgentName, DecisionRenderedPayload, CandidateRoute, Settings.

For every service: add services/<name> as a uv workspace member (root pyproject already globs services/* from FEAT-001), declare acip-common = { workspace = true } under [tool.uv.sources] in the service pyproject, write a non-root python:3.11-slim Dockerfile that installs via uv, implement GET /healthz (liveness) + GET /readyz (readiness; ml-scoring gates on model load) and bind trace_id from request/envelope where applicable. Run uv sync so the new members resolve.
Write pytest unit tests per service covering the core logic (see verification).
acceptance_criteria: payment-processor-sim POST /v1/charge returns CAPTURED/DECLINED/failure driven by sim_approval_rate / sim_latency_ms / sim_failure_mode, deterministic under a fixed seed in tests.

ml-scoring-service loads artifacts via model_card.json and /readyz gates on load; POST /v1/score returns score+top_features+model_version; with artifacts absent it serves the heuristic with model_version 'heuristic-v1'.
llm-gateway POST /v1/complete returns a normalized structured rationale; with LLM_PROVIDER=gemini and no ADC creds the circuit breaker degrades to the mock provider and still returns a response.

decision-engine POST /v1/decide implements hard-veto-then-weighted-band with config thresholds and the missing-verdict policy; the all-missing (zero-verdict) case returns the configured default (CHALLENGE).
All four services are uv workspace members with acip-common path/workspace dep, each has a non-root python:3.11-slim Dockerfile and GET /healthz + /readyz.
verification: uv run pytest services/payment-processor-sim services/ml-scoring-service services/llm-gateway services/decision-engine  (all pass, incl. heuristic-fallback, provider-fallback, and all aggregation-branch tests)
uv run ruff check services/payment-processor-sim services/ml-scoring-service services/llm-gateway services/decision-engine  (clean)
uv run mypy services/payment-processor-sim services/ml-scoring-service services/llm-gateway services/decision-engine  (clean, strict)
